Row '昭和 8', col '許可 — 阿片煙膏吸食器具販賣人': [?] — smudged, reads 17 but the first digit is covered by an ink blot (1 vs 2); the printed total 501 would need 17.
Row '臺北', col '指定 — 藥用阿片元賣捌人': read as 1 (the stroke is faint and partly lost in the column rule); the printed total 73 also needs 1.

Checks (python3): every row 總數 = sum of the five columns (昭和8 with the [?] cell taken as 17); the eight 州廳 rows sum to 348 = 昭和13 總數, and each of the five columns sums to the 昭和13 figure (43, 7, 286, 3, 9 — checked) . The 昭和13 row label '13' preceded by 〃 (printed as 同).

en.d: Gives designated wholesalers of opium paste and medicinal opium and licensed retailers and makers and sellers of opium-smoking utensils, 1933–1938 and by prefecture and district.
